diagnostic: Leave-one-person-out Brier loss reduction versus leave-one-person-out population baseline. Negative values retained.
matching: Shipping demographic backoff ladder; first rung with >=5 other observed people and effective training n>=3; otherwise population.
bands: All 15 existing ATTITUDE_VOCAB dimensions. Same adapter decoding for real R9; stored library bands only.
balance: Iterative proportional fitting of library weights to complete-key R9 weighted marginals on the six join keys. No outcome enters weights.
interpretation: Warning for investigation, not a statistical significance claim, calibrated safety threshold, overall validation score, or authorisation for paid calls. Below threshold does not prove realism.
size_matching: Uniform R9 subsampling without replacement to the observed library dimension count, retaining R9 survey weights. 5th/95th percentiles describe resample sensitivity, not confidence intervals.
missingness: Exclude unknown grouping keys; per-dimension missing bands excluded explicitly. Record population_draw/population_fallback tags; do not infer individual original refusals.
invariants: No persona edits, donor refusion, model calls, or frozen R10 list changes. Preserve original diagnostic outputs.
